exposure.needed: whether the cert-manager-managed Kubernetes Ingress path whose pathType changed (e.g. during ingress-based ACME challenge solving) is exercised at runtime

consequence.statement: cert-manager now sets the Kubernetes Ingress pathType to Exact instead of ImplementationSpecific, so ingress controllers match the affected path exactly rather than in an implementation-specific way — described by the release as improving reliable handling of ingress controllers and security; no failure is stated.
consequence.remediation: No action is stated by the release; verify that the ingress controller in use still routes the affected Ingress path as expected with pathType: Exact.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 changes the Kubernetes Ingress `pathType` it sets from `ImplementationSpecific` to `Exact`, for more reliable handling of ingress controllers and enhanced security.
